name: memory-store
description: pgvector-backed operation memory. Tenant-scoped — every query filters by tenant_id. Three-stage retrieval: semantic search → Jaccard filter → outcome reranking.

tools.name: store_operation
tools.description: Write an operation to the memory store after a human decision.

tools.name: semantic_search
tools.description: Stage 1: cosine similarity search over pgvector embeddings.

tools.name: filter_by_table_overlap
tools.description: Stage 2: Jaccard similarity filter on affected table sets.

tools.name: rerank_by_outcome
tools.description: Stage 3: outcome-aware reranking returning top-k by rerank score.

tools.name: get_confidence_scores
tools.description: Return confidence score for a table + operation_type combination.

tools.name: check_auto_reject_pattern
tools.description: Check if this operation matches a previously auto-rejected pattern within the lookback window.
